name: Leaderboard
summary: Best score per person for a game, for everyone, only my friends, or a Group's members.
when_to_use: Any scored game: rank against friends or a Group.

name: Beat my score challenge
summary: Send a "beat my score" challenge for a game to up to 20 friends and see who beat it.
when_to_use: Async friend play: pairs with beat_target and ghost_score on the game side.

name: Group games
summary: Games made for a Group or Event, listed on that Group, with member-only leaderboards.
when_to_use: Group daily sets, team totals (with shared_progress) and games about a Group.

name: Blend
aliases: games for a set of people
summary: Builds a game spec for a set of people from their skill, taste and recent games.
when_to_use: Making one game a specific group of friends will all enjoy.

name: Next level or remix
summary: Makes a new game from an existing one: a tweak, a new look, a next level or a remix (remixOf is set).
when_to_use: Level progression across games and remixing a friend's game.
